english.title: Drivers hours - permit driver to fail to take minimum daily rest in 24 hour period
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), not to have a daily rest period of at least

(A)_[eleven]_
(B)_[nine]_
(C)_[twelve hours in total including a period of at least nine]_

consecutive hours in contravention of Article 8(1) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit driver of a motor vehicle
to fail to take daily rest period of at least nine/eleven/twelve hours in total
including a period of at least nine consecutive hours

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) See Article 8(1) for circumstances in which the rest period may be reduced.
(ii) Where the place of the offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H2632 and H3171.
(v) In the Statement of Facts further detail may be included at the **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) option in addition to the identity of the driver, e.g. the defendant's capacity ("caused Mr Peter Jones, who was employed by him as a driver, )
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to have a rest period of **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT OF REST HOURS..) hours.

This did not meet the requirement of a daily rest period of

(A)_[eleven]_
(B)_[nine]_
(C)_[twelve hours in total including a period of at least nine]_

consecutive hours.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
